articles.title: Teradata Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2023 Financial Results

articles.summary: Customers of Teradata’s ClearScape Analytics experienced increased profitability through a notable improvement in data scientist productivity, faster time-to-market, scaling of artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) model deployment, and more. Those were among the conclusions announced today in a Forrester Consulting Total Economic ImpactTM (TEI) study commissioned by Teradata.
articles.title: Teradata’s ClearScape Analytics Shows Nearly 250% ROI, According to Total Economic Impact Study

articles.summary: HCA Healthcare is moving certain operational data and analytic workloads to Teradata VantageCloud on Google Cloud as part of its cloud data strategy.
articles.title: HCA Healthcare Selects Teradata VantageCloud to Complement Data Strategy

articles.summary: Teradata Corporation announced that it will release its 2023 fourth quarter and full year 2023 financial results after the market closes on Monday, February 12, 2023.
